task: Classify mice by genotype (control c or trisomic t, the Ts65Dn model of Down syndrome), learning protocol (context-shock CS or shock-context SC) and treatment (memantine m or saline s) from protein expression in the cerebral cortex.
dataset_description: Expression levels of 77 proteins and protein modifications measured by reverse phase protein arrays in the nuclear fraction of cortex samples. Names are protein symbols with suffix _N; a leading p means a phosphorylated form (e.g. pERK_N).
